retrievalProfile.description: A centered male portrait integrated into a stylized landscape with a thick red border and geometric title bars.
triggerTerms: warm sepia and red color palette
excludeWhen: neon or high-contrast digital aesthetics are requested
sans-serif typography is the primary focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A central realistic portrait of a man with dark feathered hair, framed by a landscape featuring bamboo, small birds, and a distant figure with a parasol. The entire scene is enclosed in a thick red outer border with a horizontal title bar at the top and vertical bars on the sides containing geometric sans-serif lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Central portrait overlapping a detailed landscape
Thick red outer frame containing all elements
Horizontal and vertical title bars intersecting at corners
Warm earth-toned illustration contrasted against a solid red border
coreInvariants: Geometric sans-serif typography in dedicated rectangular bars
Warm, sepia-influenced color palette for the central illustration

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large centered portrait occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top horizontal title bar, down to the central face, then outward to the side vertical text bars.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with illustration and graphic borders.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the border; muted, painterly values in the central portrait.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' lacks a crossbar or has a very low one
The 'S' is highly geometric and compressed

composition.position: Top horizontal bar and side vertical bars

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in different orientations (horizontal and vertical).

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 80s aesthetic and uniform stroke weight.
Provides the necessary geometric circularity for the 'O' and 'C'.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a painterly 80s-style portrait of a man with feathered hair against a sepia-toned landscape with bamboo and birds, all within a thick red square frame that has empty yellow bars at the top and sides.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Typeset the title in a black geometric sans-serif font like Futura, centered within the top horizontal bar and the side vertical bars.

verificationChecks: Is the red border thick and solid?
Are the text bars pale yellow and rectangular?
Is the font a clean, geometric sans-serif?
Is the central image a warm-toned illustration?

adjustableVariables: Landscape elements (e.g., changing bamboo to pine)
mustRedesign: Specific artist names or album titles
Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Strict geometric alignment of the border elements

postGenerationChecks: Check that text is perfectly centered in the bars
Ensure the red border is uniform on all sides
Verify the illustration has a painterly, non-photographic texture
Confirm the side text is rotated correctly
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered Portrait + Chinoiserie Landscape + Geometric Border Bars + Red Frame
